faq.a: Professional uses clean word pairs (name-like, no leetspeak). Gamer adds edgier words and optional digits. Funny uses playful, absurd combinations. All are adjective + noun patterns with optional numbers.

heroSubtitle: Stuck on a username? Generate a batch of ideas in your style and pick the one that feels like you.
metaDescription: Generate username ideas instantly — gamer, professional and funny styles, with optional numbers. Fresh batch every click. No availability claims, just ideas.
